description: This file contains utility functions for managing tenant selection in a frontend application, including functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear active tenant in localStorage, fetch tenants from the server, and select a tenant via API calls.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Extracts a tenant id from various structures, returning a string or null.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from localStorage, with backward compatibility.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in localStorage, cleaning up legacy keys.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from localStorage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches the list of authorized tenants for the current user from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant via backend API and updates localStorage accordingly.
